name: awesome-graph
desc: A curated list of resources for graph databases and graph computing tools

resources.name: AgensGraph
resources.desc: multi-model graph database with SQL and Cypher support

resources.name: AnzoGraph
resources.desc: Massively parallel graph database with advanced analytics (SPARQL, Cypher, OWL/RDFS+, LPG)

resources.name: ArcadeDB
resources.desc: open-source multi-model database supporting graphs, documents, key-value, time series and vector embeddings with SQL, Cypher, Gremlin and GraphQL query languages

resources.name: Atomic-Server
resources.desc: open-source type-safe graph database server with GUI, written in rust. Supports Atomic Data, JSON & RDF.

resources.name: ArangoDB
resources.desc: highly available Multi-Model NoSQL database

resources.name: Blazegraph
resources.desc: GPU accelerated graph database

resources.name: Cayley
resources.desc: open source database written in Go

resources.name: CosmosDB
resources.desc: cloud-based multi-model database with support for TinkerPop3

resources.name: Dgraph
resources.desc: Fast, Transactional, Distributed Graph Database (open source, written in Go)

resources.name: DSE Graph
resources.desc: Graph layer on top of DataStax Enterprise (Cassandra, SolR, Spark)

resources.name: Grafito
resources.desc: Portable, Serverless & Lightweight SQLite-based Graph Database in Arturo

resources.name: Grakn.AI
resources.desc: a distributed hyper-relational database for knowledge-oriented systems, i.e. a distributed knowledge base

resources.name: Graphd
resources.desc: the Metaweb/Freebase Graph Repository

resources.name: JanusGraph
resources.desc: an open-source, distributed graph database with pluggable storage and indexing backends

resources.name: Memgraph
resources.desc: High Performance, In-Memory, Transactional Graph Database

resources.name: Neo4j
resources.desc: OLTP graph database

resources.name: Nebula Graph
resources.desc: A distributed, fast open-source graph database featuring horizontal scalability and high availability

resources.name: Sparksee
resources.desc: makes space and performance compatible with a small footprint and a fast analysis of large networks

resources.name: Stardog
resources.desc: RDF graph database with OLTP and OLAP support

resources.name: OrientDB
resources.desc: Distributed Multi-Model NoSQL Database with a Graph Database Engine

resources.name: TigerGraph
resources.desc: The First Native Parallel Graph capable of real-time analytics on web-scale data

resources.name: Weaviate
resources.desc: Weaviate is a cloud-native, modular, real-time vector search engine with a graph data model (GraphQL interface) built to scale your machine learning models.

resources.name: Akutan
resources.desc: Akutan is a distributed knowledge graph store, sometimes called an RDF store or a triple store

resources.name: AllegroGraph
resources.desc: high-performance, persistent graph database that scales to billions of quads

resources.name: Apache Jena
resources.desc: open source Java framework for building Semantic Web and Linked Data applications

resources.name: Eclipse RDF4J
resources.desc: (formerly known as Sesame) is an open source Java framework for processing RDF data. This includes parsing, storing, inferencing and querying of/over such data. It offers an easy-to-use API that can be connected to all leading RDF storage solutions. It allows you to connect with SPARQL endpoints and create applications that leverage the power of linked data and Semantic Web.

resources.name: GraphDB
resources.desc: enterprise ready Semantic Graph Database, compliant with W3C Standards

resources.name: Virtuoso
resources.desc: a "Data Junction Box" that drives enterprise and individual agility by deriving a Semantic Web of Linked Data from existing data silos

resources.name: Hoply
resources.desc: explore bigger than RAM relational data in the comfort of Python.

resources.name: Apache Giraph
resources.desc: an iterative graph processing system built for high scalability

resources.name: Apache TinkerPop
resources.desc: a graph computing framework for both graph databases (OLTP) and graph analytic systems (OLAP)

resources.name: Apache Spark - GraphX
resources.desc: Apache Spark's API for graphs and graph-parallel computation

resources.name: GraphScope
resources.desc: A one-stop large-scale graph computing system from Alibaba

resources.name: JanusGraph @ Google Cloud Platform
resources.desc: JanusGraph on Google Kubernetes Engine backed by Google Cloud Bigtable

resources.name: Neptune @ Amazon Web Services
resources.desc: a fast, reliable, fully-managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications that work with highly connected datasets

resources.desc: reference documentation

resources.desc: minimum survival kit for any Gremlin user, 10 blog post series by Doan DuyHai
